components.name: Primary Laser CTA
components.description: Primary high-conversion button for brief creation and key actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #00f2fe; color: #08090d; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.5); background: #38bdf8; }

components.name: Secondary Monolith Button
components.description: Secondary exploratory button for service catalogs and documentation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #0f121d; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #1e263d; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); background: #161b2a; color: #00f2fe; }

components.name: Operational Status Badge
components.description: Live uptime and project availability indicator pill.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.25); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4); color: #34d399; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-pulse-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #10b981; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #10b981; }

narrative.overview: Tylcao's visual world embodies hyper-disciplined dark architecture with sharp electric laser lines and measured data density. Grounded in the spirit of the Andean wildcat Tilcayo (Leopardus tilcayo), it marries deep-tech engineering with tactile command-line utility.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian Monolith Surfaces (#08090d to #0f121d with zero milky wash)
Precision Laser Accents (Electric cyan #00f2fe, emerald #10b981, spectral violet #8b5cf6)
Instrument-Grade Typography (Geist Sans paired with disciplined Geist Mono)
Tactile Material Feedback (Hairline slate boundaries that react with ambient glows)

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Neon cyan is an electrical spark, not wallpaper. It must never occupy more than 8% of any given screen area.

rules.name: The Solid Typography Rule
rules.body: Decorative multi-color gradient text is forbidden on headlines. Headings must be rendered in solid high-contrast white.

rules.name: The Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Emerald is an operational truth token. It signals active servers and verified status; it is never decorative filler.

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Body copy must never drop below 14px (text-sm). Long paragraph blocks at 12px (text-xs) are strictly prohibited.

rules.name: The Monospace Guardrail Rule
rules.body: Monospace is an instrument of technical evidence, not a styling shortcut.

rules.name: The No-Redundancy Rule
rules.body: A service capability or service pillar may be presented at full depth exactly once per page.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: All surfaces rest flat at rest with crisp hairline borders. Ambient glows activate strictly on user interaction.

dos: Do wrap all Braille and block-character ASCII art in aria-hidden="true" with an accessible descriptive label.
Do set primary body and descriptive copy to at least 14px (text-sm) with high-contrast text.
Do maintain strict parity between Startup and Enterprise pathways.
Do present verified capabilities, real delivery turnaround windows (1–4 weeks), and concrete tech stacks.
Do reserve emerald (#10b981) exclusively for uptime, verification, and live telemetry.
donts: Don't use multi-color gradient text across headings.
Don't tile synthetic 40px blueprint grid lines across the entire page body.
Don't fabricate client names, fake enterprise logos, or unverified performance metrics.
Don't apply monospace typography to general body text or standard navigational links.
Don't display sticky viewport overlays that lack a user-accessible minimize or dismiss button.
